districts.body: District statistics use latest non-outdated standard Döner prices and show average, median, minimum, maximum, sample count, and last update.
districts.title: District statistics

freshness.body: Prices older than 180 days are marked outdated and excluded from default rankings. Confidence is adjusted by data age.
freshness.title: Freshness and confidence

limitations.body: The dataset is currently empty. If generated demo records are added later, they must be visibly marked as unverified and kept distinguishable from verified observations.
limitations.title: Limitations

rankings.body: Default rankings use standard Döner only, select the latest price per shop, and exclude outdated observations.
rankings.title: Ranking rules

review.body: Submissions are manually reviewed before publication. The MVP does not publish real-time user submissions.
review.title: Manual review

sources.body: The app reads static CSV and JSON files at build or server-render time. Public data should contain only reviewed information safe to publish.
sources.title: Static sources

MethodologyPage.title: Methodology and data caveats

corrections.bodyContact: Use the configured public correction contact for wrong prices, closed shops, address issues, duplicates, or metadata fixes.
corrections.bodyGithub: No separate correction contact is configured yet, so corrections use the structured GitHub fallback.
corrections.title: Corrections

form.bodyAvailable: Use the configured public form for non-technical price submissions. The form must not require private credentials.
form.bodyUnavailable: No public form is configured yet. GitHub issue forms remain available for structured submissions.
form.title: Public form

github.body: Use the structured GitHub issue form for a price observation with shop, address, product, date, price, and source context.
github.title: GitHub price issue

SubmitPage.intro: Contribution paths are intentionally simple and manually reviewed before publication.
SubmitPage.reviewNotice: Submitted prices should include a date, shop address, product type, and source or evidence type. Nothing becomes public without review.
